t: Why Did Amazon buy MGM? - Entertainment Strategy Guy
s: August 4, 2021 - After IP, the other go-to narrative for why Amazon bought MGM was that Amazon wants to “sell you more socks”. But…don’t we all already know that? Isn’t that what Prime Video and Amazon Studios were doing anyways? I feel like I’ve written about that for years. To make this slightly more charitable, the argument is that because Amazon has a complex business model—they sell more Prime subscriptions because of Prime Video, and those Prime members buy more stuff on Amazon—they can extract more value from MGM then MGM could extract by selling films and shows to other streamers.
